messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: P100122 - inference-core p99_latency SLO burn (service: inference-core). Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/P100122

Alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it. seeing p99 ~1.9s for eu-west model-inference-blue-2026-03. p95 ~320ms.

Maya (sre): noted. digging into autoscaler and kube events. autoscaler scaled twice in last 3m, pods Pending -> CrashLoopBackOff in one AZ.

Priya (infra): checking GPU queue depth + NVLink errors. NVLink errors spike ~03:12 UTC. Also KV-cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 45% around the same time.

Dan (platform): we did a staged model rollout 6m ago (variant: bfloat16-quant). Could be rollout-related. Traffic was shifted 15% to the new variant.

Alex (oncall): action plan: 1) hold rollout (rollback traffic to stable) 2) enable fallback routing to cpu-small model for user-facing low-latency traffic 3) open a PD bridge if escalates. Who can rollback?

Dan (platform): rolling traffic back now via router: `rtr traffic set inference-core stable --percent 100` (running).

incident-bot: Router: traffic shift completed, stable now at 100%.

Maya (sre): logs show sidecar OOMs on node gpu-eu-west-3-12. `kubelet` restarts correlate with p99 spikes. Possibly higher KV cache memory per-session + slower eviction.

Priya (infra): increasing nodegroup min size by 2 in eu-west: `gcloud container node-pools resize ng-gpu-eu-west --num-nodes=6` — starting. Also temporarily relaxing pod anti-affinity to let pods place.

Ellen (support): getting customer reports. A handful of active customers in EU complaining about slow replies and timeouts. Triage ticket #INC-821 created.

Alex (oncall): Maya, Priya—please confirm if rollback + node add reduces p99. If not, we'll enable model-variant fallback.

Maya (sre): tied resource graph here: `svc/inference-core -> queue-length` jumped 4x, cpu sidecar latencies increased. After rollback, CPU util dropped slightly but p99 still at ~1.3s.

Priya (infra): new nodes are provisioning, should be ready in ~90s. Also clearing prefix cache on sidecars for the failing model: `kubectl exec -it sidecar-xyz -- /bin/sh -c \"rm -f /var/cache/kvprefix/*\"` — done.

Dan (platform): enabling routing rule to send small requests (<256 tokens) to cpu-small variant: `rtr rule add inference-core token_size < 256 -> cpu-small` — enabled.

Alex (oncall): good. enabling that should reduce load on GPU pool.

Maya (sre): after node add + cache clear + small-request routing, p99 dropped to ~720ms. p95 ~300ms. Still above SLO target (500ms p99), but much improved.

Ellen (support): updated customers: "We're aware of degraded latency in EU, mitigation in progress; will follow up in 30m" :thumbsup:.

Priya (infra): there's a persistent NVLink ECC error on gpu-eu-west-3-12 that suggests hardware flakiness. Marked that node cordoned for replacement.

Dan (platform): starting a canary rollback probe to 5% new variant to confirm stability before re-deploy. Holding at 0% until we verify metrics.

Alex (oncall): summary for PD: rollback executed, nodegroup scaled, cache cleared, small-request routing enabled. p99 improved from 1.9s -> 720ms. Owner: Alex (oncall) until 03:00 UTC.

pagerduty: Incident P100122 acknowledged by Alex (oncall).

Maya (sre): follow-up actions: 1) run model warmup to refill KV cache with common prefixes 2) add eviction tuning to sidecar to prevent thrash 3) add temporary autoscaler headroom for 30m.

Priya (infra): I'll file a hardware replacement ticket for node gpu-eu-west-3-12 and isolate it for now.

Dan (platform): I'll add a short-lived routing rule that prefers cache-warmed instances for heavy prompts. Also will add a monitoring alert for KV cache hitrate drop to trigger earlier.

Alex (oncall): handing off to Maya for the longer-term postmortem and to close once hardware/pipeline stable. I'm leaving the incident channel in 15m.

Maya (sre): ack. I'll own the post-incident follow-up, will start an incident doc and ping infra + platform for root cause analysis.

Ellen (support): ETA for customer update?

Maya (sre): will send a follow-up update in 20m with current mitigations and expected timeline.

Alex (oncall): thanks all. marking incident as mitigated for now but keeping channel open for next 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P100122 status: mitigated (reduced latency) — incident channel will remain open for 30 minutes for verification.

Dan (platform): TODO: add canary checks for bfloat16-quant variant to gating pipeline.

Maya (sre): will start drafting retro, likely triggers: insufficient canary volume, KV cache tuning mismatch with variant, and a flaky GPU node.

Priya (infra): noted. hardware ticket created: HW-4921.

Ellen (support): closing customer tickets with note once Maya posts the update.

Alex (oncall): handing off officially to Maya. I'm OOO for next 2h. Good job team. :clap:
